messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a new console card to show per-invocation marginal cost, cache delta, and a simple SLO budget indicator. Want quick UX/telemetry feedback before I wire it to the backend.

ashwin: Nice. Is that per-route only or do you want per-model toggles?

maria: Per-route primary, with a per-model toggle. Goal is to make it obvious when caching is the main cost saver vs when model token inflation (long completions/rollouts) is driving spend.

kevin: For non-ML PMs, please add one-line human explainers. Something like: "This request cost $0.012 = model tokens ($0.010) + uncached tokens ($0.0018) + infra amortization ($0.0002)". Short and exportable.

toni: Also: averaged means nothing for bursts. Show median + 95th percentile band on the sparkline. Maybe a checkbox: show per-invocation sample points.

maria: Thinking: sparkline with median line, shaded 95th band, a 'cached_token_pct' small stat, and an 'Explain cost' modal that expands the breakdown.

ashwin: Telemetry question: do we have token-level cache-hit at invocation granularity? We currently log cache.hit_bytes and request.token_count but not a clean cached_tokens field.

ashwin: We could estimate saved tokens by comparing request.prefix_len vs full prompt tokens but that's noisy for LLM chains. Alternatively sample 1% of requests and compute exact token delta offline.

kevin: Sampling is acceptable as long as the sample pipeline ties back to billing windows for sanity checks. We don't want the dashboard to diverge from invoiced amounts by a lot.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/eco-cost-cards -> staging at 2024-11-02T08:00Z.

maria: Wireframe posted: https://figma.com/s/xBd-example (mock link). Key CTA: "Investigate" (opens pre-built query) and "Export sample".

toni: UX request: make the 'Budget remaining' chip color-coded relative to projected spend-rate over 30d. Red if burn rate exceeds configured SLO by >10%.

ashwin: Backend plan sketch: add a token_savings_sample table (sample_id, route, model, request_hash, cached_tokens, uncached_tokens, timestamp) and an hourly rollup job that computes median/95th and cached_pct per-route.

kevin: For the one-line explainer, use localized currency decimals and show both per-invocation and per-1k-tokens fallback rate when data sparse.

maria: Open question: how do we credit shared prefetch cache savings across routes that share the same model hot-path?

toni: For MVP show a "shared cache" flag with explanatory tooltip and surface conservative crediting (split evenly across touching routes) until we have better lineage signals.

kevin: Also add an "Investigate" CTA that opens a timeboxed runbook + saved query for engs and a "Report discrepancy" button for billing ops.

maria: Great — I'll update the wireframes with median+95th, sample export, and shared-cache footnote, then post another mock early next week.

kevin: :thumbsup:

ashwin: +1, I'll prototype the sampling pipeline and share rough storage/ingest numbers.

ops-bot: Staging deploy succeeded: feature/eco-cost-cards at 2024-11-02T08:12Z.
